metadata.name: split_risk_pool
metadata.description: YieldShield core split-risk pool + factory/registry + position NFTs.

instructions.name: accept_governance_authority
docs: Accept a pending governance-authority transfer (gov SEC-003).

instructions.name: accrue_fees
docs: Accrue fees on one Shield position from price appreciation (per-position; SEC-105).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless cranker (pays the tx; no authority required).

instructions.name: activate_shielded
docs: Cross-asset Shield exit / activation after minimum_pool_time (REQ-004).

instructions.name: add_token
docs: Whitelist a token for use in pools (governance-gated).

instructions.name: add_token_initial
docs: Whitelist a token during the bootstrap phase (EVM addTokenInitial).

instructions.name: advance_protector_epoch
docs: Advance the protector epoch after a full backing drain (permissionless; SEC-104).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless cranker (pays for the epoch snapshot PDA).

instructions.name: allow_account
docs: Add an account to an access-control allowlist (signed by the ACL authority).

accounts.name: acl_authority
docs: The access-control authority (owns this allowlist).

instructions.name: cancel_unlock
docs: Cancel a pending protector unlock (REQ-005).

instructions.name: claim_commission
docs: Claim a protector's accrued commission (REQ-006; callable while paused).

accounts.name: protector_epoch
docs: Required only when the position is in an expired epoch (`position.epoch < pool.epoch`):
the epoch's frozen accumulator (EVM `protectorEpochFinalRewardPerShare`).

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Claim Shield-side rewards subject to CLAIM_REWARDS_COOLDOWN (REQ-006).

instructions.name: close_pool
docs: Close an empty pool and refund the creation bond (AC-106; governance-gated).

accounts.name: creator
docs: Rent + bond destination; must match `pool.creator`.

accounts.name: creator_backing_account
docs: Creator's backing-token account; receives the refunded bond.

instructions.name: create_pool
docs: Create a pool: Pool + PoolConfig + vaults + bond escrow (REQ-010, CON-109).

accounts.name: shielded_token_entry
docs: Whitelist entry for the shielded asset (PDA existence proves it is whitelisted).

accounts.name: backing_token_entry
docs: Whitelist entry for the backing asset.

accounts.name: creator_backing_account
docs: Creator's backing-token account; source of the creation bond.

accounts.name: oracle_program
docs: new pool records as `price_oracle`. Only read when a USD bond floor is enforced.

instructions.name: deactivate_dust_pool
docs: Deactivate a dust pool, forfeiting the bond to the protocol recipient (governance-gated).

accounts.name: recipient_account
docs: Protocol fee recipient's backing account (the bond forfeit destination).

instructions.name: deactivate_pool
docs: Deactivate a pool (governance-gated).

instructions.name: deactivate_protector_only_pool
docs: Deactivate a protector-only pool, forfeiting the bond (governance-gated).

accounts.name: recipient_account
docs: Protocol fee recipient's backing account (the bond forfeit destination).

instructions.name: deposit_backing
docs: Open a Protector (underwriter) position (REQ-002).

accounts.name: allow_entry
docs: Required only when the pool has access control: the depositor's `AllowEntry` PDA.

instructions.name: deposit_shielded
docs: Open a Shield (protected) position (REQ-001).

accounts.name: position_mint
docs: Position NFT mint (Token-2022, supply 1, 0 decimals; mint+freeze authority = pool).

accounts.name: owner_position_account
docs: Owner's ATA for the position NFT.

accounts.name: shield_position
docs: Position data, keyed by the NFT mint.

accounts.name: asset_token_program
docs: Token program of the shielded *asset* (SPL or Token-2022).

accounts.name: position_token_program
docs: Token-2022 program for the position NFT.

accounts.name: allow_entry
docs: Required only when the pool has access control: the depositor's `AllowEntry` PDA.

instructions.name: disallow_account
docs: Remove an account from an access-control allowlist (signed by the ACL authority).

instructions.name: finalize_bootstrap
docs: Finalize governance bootstrap (one-way; governance-gated).

instructions.name: forfeit_commission
docs: Forfeit a protector's accrued commission to the protocol fee (REQ-006).

accounts.name: protector_epoch
docs: Required only when the position is in an expired epoch (`position.epoch < pool.epoch`):
the epoch's frozen accumulator (EVM `protectorEpochFinalRewardPerShare`).

instructions.name: init_factory
docs: Initialize the protocol registry singleton (ARC-002, REQ-010..012).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the `Factory` PDA.

accounts.name: factory
docs: The registry singleton — seeds `["factory"]`.

instructions.name: partial_withdraw_protector
docs: Partially exit a Protector position in place after the unlock cooldown (REQ-005).

instructions.name: partial_withdraw_shielded
docs: Partially exit a Shield position in place, same-asset (REQ-003).

accounts.name: owner_position_account
docs: Position NFT must be owned by the signer (proves position ownership without burning).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pause the protocol (governance-gated).

instructions.name: pay_pool_fee
docs: Pay out the accumulated pool-creator fee (REQ-009).

accounts.name: recipient_account
docs: Recipient token account (its authority must match the configured recipient).

instructions.name: pay_protocol_fee
docs: Pay out the accumulated protocol fee (REQ-009).

accounts.name: recipient_account
docs: Recipient token account (its authority must match the configured recipient).

instructions.name: remove_token
docs: Remove a token from the whitelist (governance-gated).

instructions.name: set_governance_authority
docs: Begin a two-step governance-authority transfer (gov SEC-003).

instructions.name: set_max_active_pools
docs: Set the maximum active-pool count (governance-gated).

instructions.name: set_minimum_creation_bond_usd
docs: Set the minimum creation bond (USD 8-decimal; governance-gated).

instructions.name: set_token_requires_strict_protected_price
docs: Toggle a token's strict-protected-price requirement (governance-gated).

instructions.name: settle_expired_protector_position
docs: Settle an expired-epoch protector position (REQ-007).

accounts.name: owner_position_account
docs: Position NFT must still exist with its owner (proves the position is live).

instructions.name: start_unlock
docs: Begin the protector unlock cooldown (REQ-005).

instructions.name: sweep_inactive_protector_backing_dust
docs: Recover inactive protector backing dust to the protocol recipient (governance-gated).

accounts.name: recipient_account
docs: Recipient backing account (must be owned by the protocol fee recipient).

instructions.name: sweep_unaccounted_surplus
docs: Recover unaccounted token surplus on an empty pool (governance-gated).

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Unpause the protocol (governance-gated).

instructions.name: update_minimum_collateral
docs: Update a token's minimum collateral ratio (governance-gated).

instructions.name: update_pool_config
docs: Governance update of a pool's mutable configuration (REQ-008, CON-101..109).

instructions.name: withdraw_protector
docs: Fully exit a Protector position after the unlock cooldown (REQ-005).

instructions.name: withdraw_shielded
docs: Fully exit a Shield position, same-asset (REQ-003).

types.name: AllowEntry
docs: Allowlist marker — PDA seeds `["allow", acl_authority, account]`. Existence = allowed.

fields.name: acl
docs: The access-control authority that owns this allowlist.

fields.name: account
docs: The allowed account.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: CreatePoolParams
docs: Caller-supplied pool parameters. Immutables (rates) go on `Pool`; the rest on `PoolConfig`.

fields.name: creation_bond_amount
docs: Creation bond, in backing-token native units.

fields.name: access_control
docs: Optional access-control authority (EVM `createPoolWithAccessControl`); `None` = open pool.

types.name: Factory
docs: Protocol registry singleton — PDA seeds `["factory"]`.
Holds the v1 stored governance authority (D3 / GOV-001), the default oracle program, pool
accounting counters, and the global creation-bond / active-pool limits.

fields.name: governance_authority
docs: Current governance authority (`has_one` target for `onlyGovernance`; gov SEC-001/003).

fields.name: pending_governance_authority
docs: Pending authority during a two-step transfer; `None` when no transfer is in flight.

fields.name: default_oracle
docs: Default `composite-oracle` config/program used when a pool does not override it.

fields.name: pool_count
docs: Total pools ever created (monotonic; never decremented).

fields.name: active_pool_count
docs: Currently active pools (≤ `max_active_pools`).

fields.name: max_active_pools
docs: CON-109 ceiling on simultaneously active pools.

fields.name: minimum_creation_bond_usd
docs: CON-109 minimum creation bond, USD 8-decimal.

fields.name: whitelisted_token_count
docs: Number of whitelisted tokens (≤ `MAX_WHITELISTED_TOKENS`).

fields.name: bootstrap_finalized
docs: True once governance bootstrap has been finalized (one-way).

fields.name: paused
docs: Global pause flag (gov pause; blocks deposits/most withdrawals).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: Pool
docs: A split-risk pool — PDA seeds `["pool", shielded_mint, backing_mint, creator]`.
Holds the pool immutables, the SEC-101 running totals, the reserved-fee accumulators
(SEC-008/103), the U256 MasterChef reward accumulator (SEC-104), and protector-epoch
bookkeeping. The 256-bit accumulator is stored as little-endian bytes (`reward_per_share`)
because `ethnum::U256` is not an Anchor type; use [`Pool::reward_per_share`] /
[`Pool::set_reward_per_share`] to convert.

fields.name: shielded_mint
docs: Shielded (protected) asset mint.

fields.name: backing_mint
docs: Backing (underwriter) asset mint.

fields.name: creator
docs: Pool creator (bond payer / pool-fee recipient default).

fields.name: commission_rate_bp
docs: `COMMISSION_RATE` in bps (CON-101).

fields.name: pool_fee_bp
docs: `POOL_FEE` in bps (CON-102).

fields.name: collateral_ratio_bp
docs: `COLLATERAL_RATIO` in bps (CON-104).

fields.name: total_shielded_tokens
docs: Σ extant shield position amounts (native shielded-token units).

fields.name: total_protector_tokens
docs: Σ extant protector claims (native backing-token units).

fields.name: total_value_at_deposit
docs: Σ extant shield position USD values (8-decimal).

fields.name: total_shield_collateral_amount
docs: Σ extant shield `collateral_amount` (backing-token units).

fields.name: accumulated_commissions
docs: Commission owed to protectors (claimable, not user-withdrawable).

fields.name: accumulated_pool_fee
docs: Pool-creator fee owed.

fields.name: accumulated_protocol_fee
docs: Protocol fee owed.

fields.name: reward_per_share
docs: MasterChef `reward_per_share`, scaled by `REWARD_PRECISION`, stored as U256 LE bytes.

fields.name: total_protector_shares
docs: Total normalized protector shares in the current epoch.

fields.name: protector_epoch
docs: Current protector epoch (increments on full backing drain via activation).

fields.name: pending_protector_reward_dust
docs: Reward tokens that did not yet move the per-share accumulator (carried forward; EVM
`pendingProtectorRewardDust`).

fields.name: current_epoch_commission_reserve
docs: Commission reserved within the current epoch (snapshotted on epoch advance; EVM
`currentEpochCommissionReserve`).

fields.name: historical_commission_reserve
docs: Commission reserved across all expired epochs awaiting settlement (EVM
`historicalCommissionReserve`).

fields.name: total_commissions_ever_accumulated
docs: Lifetime commission ever accumulated (monotonic; EVM `totalCommissionsEverAccumulated`).

fields.name: shielded_token_scale
docs: `10^shielded_decimals` — the scale used to convert shielded amounts to/from USD value
(EVM immutable `shieldedTokenScale`).

fields.name: creation_bond_amount
docs: Creation bond (backing-token units) held in the `["bond", pool]` escrow; refunded to the
creator at `close_pool` (CON-109).

fields.name: shielded_token_transfer_integrity_broken
docs: SEC-108: set when the shielded token exhibits a transfer shortfall.

fields.name: active
docs: Whether the pool is active (false after deactivation).

fields.name: position_index
docs: Monotonic position-index source for `["pos_mint", pool, index]` (OI-4; never decremented).

fields.name: shield_position_count
docs: Count of extant shield positions.

fields.name: protector_position_count
docs: Count of extant protector positions.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: PoolConfig
docs: Governance-updatable pool configuration — PDA seeds `["config", pool]` (CON-101..109, REQ-008).

fields.name: shielded_min_deposit
docs: Minimum shielded deposit (native units).

fields.name: shielded_max_deposit
docs: Maximum shielded deposit (native units).

fields.name: backing_min_deposit
docs: Minimum backing deposit (native units).

fields.name: backing_max_deposit
docs: Maximum backing deposit (native units).

fields.name: max_tvl_usd
docs: USD TVL cap (8-decimal; REQ-008).

fields.name: minimum_pool_time
docs: Minimum pool time before cross-asset activation (CON-106; REQ-004).

fields.name: unlock_duration
docs: Protector unlock cooldown (CON-105; REQ-005).

fields.name: protocol_fee_bp
docs: Protocol fee in bps (CON-103).

fields.name: protocol_fee_recipient
docs: Recipient of the protocol fee.

fields.name: pool_fee_recipient
docs: Recipient of the pool-creator fee.

fields.name: price_oracle
docs: Oracle config/program used for this pool's price reads (overrides `Factory::default_oracle`).

fields.name: access_control
docs: Optional access-control program / allowlist PDA (WS7; `None` = open).

fields.name: shield_transfer_lock
docs: Shield NFT transfer-lock duration (CON-108).

fields.name: protector_transfer_lock
docs: Protector NFT transfer-lock duration (CON-108/POS-004).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: ProtectorEpoch
docs: Snapshot of an expired protector epoch — PDA seeds `["protector_epoch", pool, epoch]`.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool this epoch belongs to.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The epoch generation number.

fields.name: final_reward_per_share
docs: `reward_per_share` frozen at epoch expiry, stored as U256 LE bytes (EVM
`protectorEpochFinalRewardPerShare`).

fields.name: remaining_shares
docs: Shares still owed settlement in this epoch (EVM `protectorEpochRemainingShares`).

fields.name: remaining_reserve
docs: Commission reserve still owed in this epoch (EVM `protectorEpochRemainingReserve`).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: ProtectorPosition
docs: Protector (underwriter) position data — PDA seeds `["protector_pos", position_mint]`.
`reward_debt` is the U256 MasterChef checkpoint (SEC-104), stored as little-endian bytes;
use [`ProtectorPosition::reward_debt`] / [`ProtectorPosition::set_reward_debt`].

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool this position belongs to.

fields.name: amount
docs: Backing-token amount (native units).

fields.name: deposit_time
docs: Entry timestamp (drives transfer lock).

fields.name: unlock_request_time
docs: Pending-unlock request time; `0` when no unlock is pending (REQ-005).

fields.name: shares
docs: Normalized MasterChef shares (SEC-104).

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: U256 reward-debt checkpoint, stored as LE bytes (SEC-104).

fields.name: commissions_claimed
docs: Cumulative commissions already claimed by this position.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Protector epoch this position was opened in (SEC-102/104).

fields.name: settled
docs: True once an expired-epoch position has been settled (EVM
`protectorEpochPositionSettled`).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: ShieldPosition
docs: Shield (protected) position data — PDA seeds `["shield_pos", position_mint]`.
Mirrors the EVM `ShieldPosition`, plus the Solana-specific link back to the owning pool.
Cooldown / fee baseline travel with the mint-keyed PDA (EVM L-14 parity).

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool this position belongs to.

fields.name: amount
docs: Shielded-token amount (native units).

fields.name: deposit_time
docs: Entry timestamp (drives transfer lock; `i64` per `Clock::unix_timestamp`).

fields.name: value_at_deposit
docs: USD value at entry, 8-decimal (basis for collateral sizing and fee high-water-mark).

fields.name: collateral_amount
docs: Backing-token collateral cap attributable to this position.

fields.name: last_fee_claim_time
docs: Last fee-crystallization timestamp.

fields.name: fee_value_baseline_usd
docs: SEC-105 per-position USD fee high-water-mark (already-taxed yield floor).

fields.name: last_claim_rewards_time
docs: Last `claim_rewards` timestamp (REQ-006 `CLAIM_REWARDS_COOLDOWN`).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: WhitelistEntry
docs: A whitelisted token entry — PDA seeds `["token", mint]` (REQ-012, CON-005/107).

fields.name: name
docs: Display name (≤ `MAX_TOKEN_NAME_LENGTH`).

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol (≤ `MAX_TOKEN_SYMBOL_LENGTH`, CON-107).

fields.name: mint
docs: The token mint this entry whitelists.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Token decimals (CON-107 range [6, 32] enforced at add time).

fields.name: primary_feed
docs: Primary oracle feed account (in `composite-oracle`) for this token.

fields.name: backup_feed
docs: Optional backup oracle feed account (dual-feed).

fields.name: min_collateral_ratio_bp
docs: Minimum collateral ratio (bps) permitted for pools backed by this token.

fields.name: requires_strict_protected_price
docs: When true, the token must expose a strict protected-price path (SEC-006).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.
